==Description==
The '''Grenade''' is one of the four common [[Consumables|consumables]]. It has a 16.67% (16.22% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 9.23% (7.06% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only up to six '''Grenades''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 20 second cooldown, though when the match first starts, the cooldown is set to 10 seconds.

==Usage==
When using the '''Grenade''', your avatar's right hand will hold a grenade, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the grenade will be thrown. This will make it create a small explosion of a 6 stud radius, dealing 125 damage to all enemies in it. Unlike other explosions, the damage does not decrease based on the distance from the center of the explosion. Additionally, the explosion can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies and despite creating an explosion, it is affected by defense.

==Appearance==
The '''Grenade''' is a green hand grenade, with a yellow line in the middle.

==Strategy==
*Early on, the '''Grenade's''' high damage proves extremely effective at clearing hordes of weaker enemies like the [[Heavy]] or [[Slow]], and even tougher ones such as the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]].
**Later on, the '''Grenade''' can only deal mere chip damage at best, and essentially becomes worthless in the final waves.
